pages.seoDescription: Who Launch Notes is and how we work: a small studio that ships software, hardware and guides, and posts every release here first.

children: Launch Notes is a small product studio that builds tools for people who make things: software, hardware, and the guides that tie them together. This is our newsroom: the front door to everything we ship and everyone who ships it.

We build in the open. Every release gets a post, every post has a name on it, and the community that uses our work helps decide what comes next. No press releases, no launch theatre. Just the makers telling you what changed and why.
